meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 可通过 BGPT MCP 服务器搜索论文数据库,返回每篇论文 25 个以上结构化字段,包括方法、结果、样本量、质量评分与结论,而非仅标题和摘要。
howto.when: 当用户要求检索科学论文、做文献综述,或索要样本量、质量评分等全文结构化数据时触发。

say.text: 搜索关于CRISPR基因编辑效率的论文
say.note: 返回方法、结果、样本量等结构化字段。

say.text: 帮我找带有质量评分的抑郁症治疗研究
say.note: 返回论文列表及其质量评分。

say.text: 汇总这些研究中的样本量和主要结论
say.note: 提取各论文的结构化数据做对比。

howto.what_en: Claude searches the BGPT MCP scientific paper database and returns 25+ structured fields per paper (methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, conclusions), not just titles and abstracts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to search for papers with specific experimental details, do a literature review, or needs full-text structured data like sample sizes or quality scores.

say_en.text: Search for papers on CRISPR gene editing efficiency
say_en.note: Returns structured fields like methods, results, sample sizes.

say_en.text: Find depression treatment studies with quality scores
say_en.note: Returns paper list with quality scores.

say_en.text: Summarize the sample sizes and main conclusions of these studies
say_en.note: Extracts structured data from each paper for comparison.
